fn:addInts.cost: O(rows). Appends a column without NULLs; the first column fixes the row count.

fn:addNullableInts.cost: O(rows). None becomes NULL; the stored filler under a NULL is never readable.

fn:aggregate.cost: O(rows * (1 + aggregates)) plus O(groups) output. Groups the rows by the key column and computes each aggregate; the result has the key column (one row per group, first appearance order) followed by the aggregate columns in the order given. At most 64 aggregates; the output column names must be unique.

fn:batch.cost: O(max * columns). The batch starting at row offset; an empty table is returned past the end, so a loop stops when rowCount of the batch is 0.

fn:build.cost: O(columns). Freezes the columns; a builder without columns gives an empty table with zero rows.

fn:builder.cost: O(1). An empty builder; columns are added with the add* functions and fixed by build.

fn:cast.cost: O(rows). An explicit, exact conversion into the column `into`: Int<->Float only when the value is represented exactly, Text parses decimal Int/Float and "true"/"false", Int 0/1 <-> Bool. Any cell that does not convert fails the whole cast with BadCast (the message never contains the cell); NULL stays NULL. Float<->Bool is not defined.

fn:cell.cost: O(columns). The Cell is Null for a NULL; the row must be inside 0..rowCount.

fn:dropColumns.cost: O(columns * dropped names). Removes the listed columns and shares the others.

fn:floatArray.cost: O(rows). Hands a dense Float column to the numeric kernels as a one-dimensional FloatArray (the cells are copied into the array once). NULLs are refused with NullValue; an empty table fails with NumericError.

fn:hasColumn.cost: O(1) after the name index lookup.

fn:head.cost: O(count * columns). The first rows; same as slice from 0.

fn:ints.cost: O(rows). Fails with NullValue when the column holds a NULL, and with TypeMismatch for another kind.

fn:isNull.cost: O(rows). Mask that is true where the column holds NULL.

fn:join.cost: O(left rows + right rows + output rows) expected; the output may be at most maxRows (1..1,000,000) rows or the join fails with JoinTooLarge before building it. Inner keeps left rows that have at least one match, Left keeps every left row (right cells are NULL when nothing matches). A NULL key never matches, not even another NULL. Left row order is kept; matches of one left row come in right row order. The result has all left columns, then the right columns except the right key; a name that appears twice fails with DuplicateName (rename first).

fn:mapFloats.cost: O(rows) calls of transform. Like mapInts for Float.

fn:mapInts.cost: O(rows) calls of transform. Writes into column `into`; NULL stays NULL and transform never sees a NULL.

fn:mapTexts.cost: O(rows) calls of transform. Like mapInts for Text.

fn:maskBools.cost: O(rows) calls of test. Like maskInts for Bool.

fn:maskFloats.cost: O(rows) calls of test. Like maskInts for Float.

fn:maskInts.cost: O(rows) calls of test. NULL rows give false, so a filter never keeps a NULL by accident.

fn:maskTexts.cost: O(rows) calls of test. Like maskInts for Text.

fn:orderBy.cost: O(rows * log rows) comparisons plus O(rows * columns) copies. The sort is stable and NULLs come last for both orders; a Float column holding NaN fails with NotComparable.

fn:rename.cost: O(columns). Shares all column data; the new name must be unused.

fn:select.cost: O(selected columns * columns). Keeps the listed columns in the listed order and shares their data.

fn:slice.cost: O(length * columns). start+length is clamped to the table; negative start or length fails with OutOfRange.

fn:takeRows.cost: O(rows kept * columns). Rows may repeat and may be reordered; an index outside 0..rowCount fails with OutOfRange.

fn:where.cost: O(rows * columns). Keeps the rows whose mask entry is true; the mask length must equal rowCount.

fn:withBools.cost: O(rows + columns). Like withInts for Bool.

fn:withFloatArray.cost: O(rows). Adds or replaces a Float column from a one-dimensional array of exactly rowCount elements.

fn:withFloats.cost: O(rows + columns). Like withInts for Float.

fn:withInts.cost: O(rows + columns). Adds the column, or replaces the one with that name; the length must equal rowCount.

fn:withTexts.cost: O(rows + columns). Like withInts for Text.
